name: StoryBox
author: thatzachfish
tagline: A storytelling music box for the FM-1
description: StoryBox turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a generative music box for storytelling: stories with acts you can play in any order, smooth or slow transitions, track mutes and breakdowns, a lead voice with a looper and punch-in effects. A fork of AMB-1 by Charles Vestal.
credits: A fork of AMB-1 by Charles Vestal. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
